reviews.text: Great place. We go here with Bunny and I can only recommend it. Doctor Pazár is the best. 😊😊 …
Professional, attentive care.

Everything was as agreed, they were able to receive us immediately, we arrived with a 3-year-old leopard gecko. Extremely prepared Doctor, kind staff. There is usually always a parking space on the street, which is paid. Thank you very much, on behalf of Kókusz.
Well-trained doctors, very kind.

It's a very expensive place, but it specializes in exotic animals, and the animals get the best possible chance to recover. We are a family of guinea pigs, we bring our pigs here for their annual general check-up, if there is anything, they will notice it here. If there is an unknown problem, they will find the cause here and give a targeted treatment. The waiting room is pleasant, nice and clean, including the toilets. You can bring your animal for emergency care if there is a big problem. It would be a great help if there was an on-call service, because there is nowhere for exotic animals, it is very much needed.
They also treated two chinchillas, and one of them lived to be 14 years old and the other to be 19.5 years old. Thanks to the expertise of Exo-pet, they lived long and active lives!

We visited here at the end of September 2024 with my elderly, very sick bunny named Zserbó. We received all the professional help and information about our prospects in a correct manner so that we could make the best possible decision. And in October, we were able to say goodbye to my bunny with dignity and without any disturbances, thanks to Dr. Boglárka Markó. If I ever have another bunny, I will only bring it here. Beyond the painful memory, with eternal gratitude!
Thank you for the professional and animal-friendly care <3

Professionally and humanly, I was satisfied with the team.
They really heal here❤️
The Doctor speaks the language of animals.
It was fantastic to see his knowledge, experience, care, and humanity all in one. The animals calm down under his hands, and at the same time he starts them on the path to healing☺️
Thank you, there are still good veterinarians who have dedicated their profession to animals, and not money.❤️❤️🩵🩵
An excellent choice for exotic animals

Dear BeuZen

We regret to see that you rated our work as unsatisfactory. Since you did not provide details of your opinion, we cannot identify which patient was dissatisfied with what type of treatment. Without these, we cannot check what the problem might have been or whether we could have done more in some way. If you feel it is important to share your complaint with us in more detail, please write an email to info@exopet.hu.
It's very special for those who haven't been to a Japanese restaurant before. I had a spicy dish with 3 peppers. I really only recommend this to those who are used to very spicy food at home.

We had to visit the clinic a few weeks ago, and we had previously agreed by phone whether they could accept us. All the staff - both professionally and personally - were extremely helpful to us. I would like to express my gratitude for their conscientious work.

Yesterday we took three chickens. We went without an appointment, but the emergency care was 8000 forints🫣. But the care was not a cheap thing.
Thanks to them the chickens are much better, even the sickest chicken is eating now.❤️
Thank you!

I am amazed to read the negative comments among the reviews of Exo-Pet. We brought our little bunny here after the previous vet did nothing worthwhile during the 3rd visit.

They were fair at Exo-Pet, I brought our bunny to them after a preliminary phone call, and they provided emergency care to our bunny, Gyuszi, within a few minutes. They did everything they could to make our bunny better. After he was admitted to the hospital for intensive care, they called twice a day regarding our bunny's condition, and always asked about everything and informed us about future examinations and treatments. We met conscientious and empathetic doctors and assistants. After our bunny unfortunately did not survive the appendicitis and blood poisoning (they immediately informed us to hurry in when his condition became critical so that we could say goodbye to him), they were also very fair when paying the final bill, we expected a much larger bill, but the 1-week hospital stay was surprisingly good value for money. They were sympathetic and we got answers to all our questions, and they gave us as much time as we needed to understand what had happened. Unfortunately, our bunny was seen by a professional doctor too late, so the intensive treatment and care proved to be useless, it was already too late for him. Unfortunately, we trusted the previous clinic a lot, which we shouldn't have. If we could go back in time and bring our bunny here in the first place, poor Gyuszi would definitely still be alive! We would like to thank the doctors and assistants who helped us through this journey with their kindness and attention. We can only recommend them to everyone!🐰🌸

Bunny owners, please always take your bunnies to a dedicated exotic veterinary clinic, and don't let distance and prices determine which clinic you go to first! Overall, we ended up cheaper with exo-pet than at the previous clinic, where in the end they only asked for the money, but did nothing to make Gyuszi better (and probably didn't understand bunnies as much as they claimed).

His illness was caused by a general dental problem, which they "didn't notice at the previous clinic", according to them, our bunny's teeth were flawless, which was eventually refuted by the doctors at Exo Pet.

This place is always a disappointment. I didn't leave an animal there at first because they would have just taken it in, the owners can't stay with them, and then they let me know when I can come pick it up. No, no. We don't leave a sick animal with strangers, in a strange place. I've already turned myself away. Then another time there was an emergency, they were sorry, there's an appointment in x days with an emergency surcharge. The third time we heard that someone brought in a sick rescued bird, a foundation took on the cost of the treatment through fundraising, they paid a lot, they mistreated it or left it alone, it will never be found out, the little bird died. I won't bring an animal here, that's for sure.

I contacted the Exopet veterinary clinic by phone yesterday afternoon, because I told the receptionist that my dwarf rabbit had a bloated belly and asked for an appointment for that afternoon, she said that I could bring the rabbit in about 1 hour. When I arrived at the clinic, I did not receive any information at the reception about the emergency surcharge, after the doctor called me in, examined the rabbit and said that since her condition was serious, she would keep her indoors, at which time she took her for an X-ray and to put her on an IV and painkillers. When I asked how much the examination and treatment that day would cost, the doctor said that it would be 60,000 HUF, then corrected herself and said that it was exactly 57,000 HUF, only then did she explain that the total amount also included an emergency surcharge. I accepted the amount because I knew that she needed urgent care and we left our dwarf rabbit indoors. The doctor said that in 70-80% of cases, the painkiller helps to dilate the intestines so that whatever is causing the blockage can move further. After I left the office, they called me shortly after and said that the bunny had died because his circulation had collapsed. I didn't see the X-ray, and he didn't mention whether it was done or what he saw on the X-ray, even though I had paid for the X-ray in advance. I can't recommend the Exopet office because I feel that the prices are too high, and in fact, they don't inform you about the emergency surcharge upon arrival at the office until after they call you in and take the pet to another room for treatment.

We brought a Greek tortoise to the emergency room with respiratory complaints. I called them the day before, they couldn't see us that day, but they told us everything and suggested other places.
Finally we came here. We had to wait because they were ahead of us, but we are completely satisfied. The tortoise was thoroughly examined, we received a lot of information and advice from the doctor. They are kind and patient not only with us, but with everyone else. We have only heard good things so far, but now we have experienced their professional attitude.

The waiting room is clean and tidy, the staff absolutely knows their job. They also came with urgent cases, but this was only evident from the fact that they brought the pet in in advance. A calm atmosphere greeted me.

They messed up my rabbit's central nervous system, they kept it cold for months, it might heal, then a doctor told me to put it to sleep because it was just suffering.. They demanded 800 thousand forints from me and they also wanted to take out its eye because it went blind.. We received disgusting and unbearable information. I do not recommend them to anyone, they only care about money and there is no professional correction in them!!!
Kind, patient service and information

At the end of the summer of 2025, my 5-year-old sailor Füles was put in the hands of the caring doctors of Exo. Dr. Tünde Pilis took him under treatment, and then
after 3 more serious tooth corrections, a huge abscess formed.
I am eternally grateful to Dr. Sátorhelyi for the surgery, because although the surgery itself seemed to have a dubious outcome, and they correctly informed me of this, he did not give up, just like Malacka.
We attended regular check-ups for half a month, then 1, and most recently for two months.
On 2026.04.28.- I got Füles back without having to correct his teeth either, I only have to take him in case of a complaint.
I would like to emphasize that, being in a wheelchair, they are very helpful with us, they take Malacka. The greatness of the Doctor is that he ALWAYS brings him out to the car, he radiates love for animals and medical dedication.
Yes, the price is high, but it reflects the knowledge.
Two previous veterinary clinics gave a totally wrong diagnosis before going to Exo for a lot of money, well that was really expensive because it didn't help the animal's problem.

Unfortunately, on June 2nd, I had to let Füles cross that bridge, at only 5.5 years old. It happened that in mid-May, Dr. Kovács diagnosed a bladder stone, which Dr. Sátorhelyi operated on two days later, my piglet started eating pee again, etc. In the last week of May, he chewed less and less hay, and even from fresh grass he only ate the leaves. Unfortunately, my suspicions became a terrifying reality, while feeling the trace of the previous abscess, I came across a small pit with careful touch, which unfortunately Füles also "commented" in a painful voice..... Yes, abscess 2.0. Dr. Sátorhelyi scheduled us for the next day, and seeing my desperation and the trouble that had developed, he very humanly said to my question, and I quote: if he were my pig, I would let him go.
This little creature has been fighting since September 2025, but I have never seen any sign of giving up. He ate and drank a lot of drugs to heal, like a pig that had undergone multiple surgeries, there was no point in poisoning him or torturing myself physically, wondering if I was doing everything right........
Dr. Sátorhelyi has been a witness to this march for months, and I am grateful for his honest words, it is better for Füles, for me. I am simultaneously burdened with grief, but at the same time the thought of becoming an owner and a herdsman again.
One thing is for sure, I have never had the thought that the assistants of the Exo doctors would not have cared for my furry friend to the best of their ability. Füles was in the best place, in the best hands, that's for sure.
Yes, the 16 (!!) examinations and consultations cost me a lot of money, not even counting fuel, special food, and the extra time I spent on them.
I think that exotic animals are always a different level of care. This requires a higher level of doctor, therapy, and training. Exos are not expensive, our money is not that worthless in my opinion. I may have made a mistake with Füles, although he was my fourth piglet since 2012. Unfortunately, I also lost his 11-month-younger half-brother due to dental problems and the abscess that developed from it in November 2022, within 2.5-3 months, but in the treatment of another hospital.

Helpful, empathetic, professional team. Our little parrot needed an urgent check-up after an injury (fortunately, it turned out to be not serious). They gave us useful advice on the phone on how to help the shocked bird, and finally, just to be safe, we went into the clinic. We were quickly seen without an appointment, the doctor was very helpful and thorough, and the receptionists/assistants were also very kind to us. The examination ended up being cheaper than we expected after other veterinary experiences. Thanks to the careful treatment, Munin did not suffer from the examination at all, on the way home he was already looking around happily from his carrier, and when he got home he and his partner were happy.
Thank you very much!

Dear Anna Hwang

We regret to see that you rated our work as unsatisfactory. Since you did not provide details of your opinion, we cannot identify which patient was dissatisfied with what type of treatment. Without these, we cannot verify what the problem might have been or whether we could have done more in some way. If you feel it is important to share your complaint with us in more detail, please write an email to info@exopet.hu.
We went with Gekko. Even after 13 years, the doctor was able to tell us something new. She is thorough and knowledgeable.

I will be forever grateful to the Exopet clinic and especially to Dr. Pazár for the loving, humane and outstanding professional work they have done for Zsele in recent years.

Zsele (a ferret) had a chronic kidney disease, we went for treatment, examinations, and check-ups for a long time, and the clinic always treated us with patience, attention and genuine care. I would also like to thank the assistant ladies for their work, who were always kind, helpful and reassuring. On such a long and difficult journey, this means a lot.

Unfortunately, I had to say goodbye to Zsele yesterday. It was one of the most painful moments of my life, but it is an infinite relief for me that Dr. Pazár was with us in this situation. He not only accompanied Zsele throughout this journey with great professional knowledge and dignity, but also me. His compassion, calmness and humanity provided such support at that moment that I will never forget.

Jselé was able to sleep peacefully and in love, and for that I will be forever grateful.

There are few veterinarians and clinics as exceptional as this one. I thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything.
MVK
They were kind and helpful. We went here for pet cremation and the compassion of the staff was evident and they were truly uplifting.

Unfortunately, they completely ignored me, I just suspect that because I would have gone with an average chick, it wasn't worth it for them.
I contacted them by email with a 2-day-old chick that had a bad leg. What was their opinion, could something be done to fix its leg (since it has to be ridden at such a young age, I would only have taken it on a long trip if it was worth it). They didn't answer. I waited for 3 days, but then I called them to say that I had written an email (I thought maybe they hadn't noticed). They said they had read it. The lady on the phone promised to call me back that day or the next day. I asked them several times to really do it, because it's a little chick, if there's anything you can do with its leg, it should be done as young as possible, I'm afraid it will be too late because of the wait. They didn't call me back. I wrote another email, but they didn't answer that either. I have already visited another doctor, but now the chick is 1 week old, and by making him wait pointlessly and unnecessarily, my last chance to improve his condition may have slipped away. A "there's nothing we can do about it" or "we don't care because it's just a chick" or any other answer would have been enough and then I wouldn't waste time, I would turn to someone else or accept that this is how it is. I know that they operate on a market basis, but they didn't even appreciate a negative answer. I don't recommend them to anyone, especially not to those who need an urgent or, according to the average opinion, less important animal.

Everyone was very friendly and helpful when we showed up with an injured pigeon and they provided him with free care :) They even offered to let us know about his condition at any time. We are incredibly grateful for the quick response.
We came for our annual mandatory check-ups, vaccinations, general check-ups, plus a soot test. Thank you very much for the professional care. Whatever it is, we always come here.
Best animal clinic.

My opinion was good before, but today it has completely changed!!! After a phone consultation, we took our guinea pig for an emergency examination, because he had lost a lot of weight in a few days and was lethargic. After waiting for three and a half hours, we brought him to another clinic. Here they said that the condition of the little pig is critical now! I think it is terrible that there was not a single doctor who could not see him in more than 3 hours!! Or they say that they cannot see him! The "kind" receptionist replied - after 2 hours I asked if they expected to see the animal - she told me that we would be the next in the emergency department. But another hour and a half passed and nothing. Then I brought him to a clinic where they saw him immediately!!! I find the way they approached the emergency department and the entire situation outrageous!!!

Answer:
A lot of things were appreciated and I accept them, but unfortunately this won't bring Nózi back... Because she got to such a state that she had to be put to sleep. The doctor who examined her by palpation could have noticed the enlarged stomach and liver, but she said her condition wasn't that bad, and then we left after waiting for 3 hours. 3 hours is a lot for such a small rodent, especially since she couldn't even drink in the carrier. They stabilized her condition in the other clinic and then X-rayed her in about 5 minutes. Unfortunately, she couldn't be saved by then and we didn't want her to suffer any longer. We definitely won't be going here again!
